name: Will replacing a warped window frame improve my home's energy efficiency?

mainEntity.name: Will replacing a warped window frame improve my home's energy efficiency?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, replacing a warped window frame can significantly improve your home's energy efficiency. A warped frame creates gaps and compromises the window's seal, leading to air leaks that allow conditioned air to escape and outside air to enter. This forces your HVAC system to work harder, increasing energy consumption. A new, properly installed frame with a well-sealed window will eliminate these drafts, enhance insulation, and contribute to more stable indoor temperatures, potentially lowering your heating and cooling costs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, replacing a warped frame eliminates air leaks and improves insulation, leading to better energy efficiency and potentially lower utility bills.
